description: The ☰ menu at the right end of the Baude main window's header bar, in sections with a rule between them as Record's: the chat's (Open in Record…, Copy Transcript for an Issue, Read-only session), the view's (Full-width text), the views over the window (Kubernetes, Database Schemas, Terminal), the app's (Settings…, Changelog, Mesh, Send Feedback…, Ongoing Feedback, Restart Baude, Restart Daemon). Items beside a check mark are toggles.

phone.does: ⋮ in the chat's header bar, with the same items where they apply (the items with does: nothing aside)
phone.why: Android's overflow menu is ⋮; the items are the desktop's
Launches the sibling desktop program Record as another process; a phone has no Record to launch

actions.does: Starts Record (or hands its running window) with this chat on its Read tab. A chat with no transcript file yet opens Record without a chat

Copies the open chat as text (app, session id, model, effort, mode, host, folder, Claude Code version, context, tools, time, then every message with each tool call's input and result) to the clipboard and shows the toast "Transcript copied". With nothing said yet, copies a short "nothing said" line

parts.name: Read-only session
parts.shows: Row "Read-only session", a check mark when on. Per chat: remembered for the chat once it has an id.

actions.does: Toggles whether this chat can be written to. On: the whole input box is hidden (not greyed), so nothing can be sent, and files dropped on the window are not taken. Off: the box comes back

parts.name: Full-width text
parts.shows: Row "Full-width text", a check mark when on. On from a fresh installation. Off limits the chat column to 860 px wide; on lets it fill the window.

actions.does: Toggles full-width chat text and remembers it (a setting shared with Settings)

decisions.said: Drop the ellipses from Kubernetes and Database Schemas
decisions.rule: Every app names the Kubernetes and Database Schemas items without an ellipsis: they open a view, not a dialog that asks for more

actions.does: Opens the Kubernetes page, laid over the whole window
Opens the Database Schemas page, laid over the whole window
Opens the Terminal view laid over the whole window, with a terminal on the host picked in the sidebar's host dropdown if it has none

parts.name: Settings…
parts.shows: First row. Label "Settings…", its key (Ctrl+, ; ⌘, on a Mac) shown at the right.

actions.does: Same, from anywhere in the window
Opens the Mesh dialog: every host's daemon and every app connected to it, by the code each runs

parts.name: Send Feedback…
parts.shows: Row "Send Feedback…", its key (Ctrl+. ; ⌘. on a Mac) at the right.

actions.does: Opens the Ongoing Feedback page in a tab of the main area

phone.why: Re-executes the desktop process and restores its windows; no equivalent on a phone

actions.does: Restarts the whole app, every window, putting back each as it was (chat, scroll place, draft, attachments, size)

parts.name: Restart Daemon
parts.shows: Last row, "Restart Daemon", right under Restart Baude. The same restart as the banner's Restart Daemon button.

phone.why: The phone's host runs inside the app, on the app's own code, so there is no separate daemon to restart.

actions.does: Restarts this machine's host process (daemon) once no command is running on it (a model turn going on is cut short and offered Continue); toast "Restarting the daemon once N sessions finish running a command" while it waits, "Daemon restarted" once it's back. With none running, starts one. No confirmation
